name: Cabin Corpse - Season 1
source: Our main character stumbles upon a strange cabin in the middle of the woods. He has no recollection as to who he is, or why the hallucinations and voices in his head guided him there. Once he gets acquainted with the house guests, he realizes all is not as it seems, and must uncover the secret behind a series of mysterious events. You must interact with other characters, gain their trust, form relationships, gather clues to uncover the truth, manipulate people, and decide their fates.
